facts.fact: INAGE, Mozambique's national e-government institute, states it developed the CloudGov file storage and sharing system for use across public administration institutions; the document gives no date for the work, so the published date is used.

INAGE's service catalogue, retrieved 2026-08-08, lists server rental, application hosting, application development and government network connection (GovNET, MoRENet) as services for public bodies; the date is the retrieval date.
INAGE states it recently developed CloudGov and that it is in the implementation phase across institutions, with no go-live date given; the published date is used.
